select tab.parent_work_effort_type_id as wet2_work_effort_type_id, tab.work_effort_type_id as wet_work_effort_type_id, wept.work_effort_purpose_type_id, tab.parent_description as wet2_description, tab.parent_description_lang as wet2_description_lang, tab.description as wet_description, tab.description_lang as wet_description_lang, wept.description, wept.description_lang, wepa.comments as wepa_comments from work_effort_purpose_type wept left join ( select wet2.work_effort_type_id as parent_work_effort_type_id, wet2.description as parent_description, wet2.description_lang as parent_description_lang, wet.work_effort_type_id, wet.description, wet.description_lang, wetc.work_effort_purpose_type_id as id_finalita, wetc.content_id from work_effort_type_content wetc inner join work_effort_type wet on wet.work_effort_type_id = wetc.work_effort_type_id inner join work_effort_type wet2 on wet2.work_effort_type_id = wet.parent_type_id union all select wet2.work_effort_type_id as parent_work_effort_type_id, wet2.description as parent_description, wet2.description_lang as parent_description_lang, wet.work_effort_type_id, wet.description, wet.description_lang, wet.we_purpose_type_id_ind as id_finalita, null from work_effort_type wet inner join work_effort_type wet2 on wet2.work_effort_type_id = wet.parent_type_id ) tab on tab.id_finalita = wept.work_effort_purpose_type_id left join work_effort_purpose_account wepa on wepa.work_effort_purpose_type_id = wept.work_effort_purpose_type_id where wept.purpose_type_enum_id = 'PT_INDICATOR' and wepa.gl_account_id = #{glAccountId}
